title: SynapseIDS · Network Intelligence
description: Traffic, classification, detections, neural inference performance, sensor health and collection loss from the SynapseIDS Prometheus endpoint.

options.content:
## Network intelligence, at a glance
**CAPTURE → FLOW FEATURES → INFERENCE → DETECTIONS → INVESTIGATION**

Choose a Prometheus data source, scrape job and daemon above. Rates follow the selected time range; counters reset on restart. Classification labels are model judgments, not confirmed incidents. [Operator documentation](https://github.com/kawaiipantsu/synapseids/wiki/Prometheus-and-Grafana)

panels.title: SCRAPE HEALTH
panels.description: Worst scrape health across selected daemons. No data means no matching scrape target; it is not a healthy zero.

panels.title: RUNNING SENSORS
panels.description: Connected SYNPOIP sensors in the running state.

panels.title: NON-NORMAL SHARE
panels.description: Share of classified results outside NORMAL. Not attack success, severity, or detection accuracy. No traffic produces no ratio.

panels.title: INFERENCE P95
panels.description: Pooled scoring-call latency across selected daemons. Histogram estimate; no samples produces no quantile.

panels.title: CONNECTED CONSOLE CLIENTS
panels.description: Current WebSocket connections. One operator can have several tabs.

panels.title: Classification activity
panels.description: Classification throughput by traffic-classes-v1 class, including remote flow/feature sensors.

panels.title: Verdict distribution · selected range
panels.description: Estimated counter increases over the selected range. A classification is not a confirmed incident.

panels.title: Managed capture bandwidth
panels.description: Capture-manager byte rate. Flow/feature sensors bypass this packet path; zero can be correct while classifications increase. _all is selected to prevent double counting.

panels.title: Managed capture packet rate
panels.description: Frames delivered by managed packet capture sources. Replay and remote record-mode paths have different accounting.

panels.title: Detection decisions
panels.description: New alerts, folded repetitions, and suppressed candidates. Suppression is a detection policy result, not a firewall block.

panels.title: Detection policy enabled
panels.description: Shows OFF if any selected daemon has alert policy disabled.

panels.title: Observed hosts
panels.description: Current investigation index entries, summed across daemons; a host seen by two daemons is counted twice.

panels.title: Model disagreements
panels.description: Estimated disagreements over the selected range among alert-driving models.

panels.title: Scoring latency · p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Histogram quantiles pooled across selected daemons; not a per-model measurement.

panels.title: Feature extraction latency · p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Daemon-side extraction only. Feature-mode sensors may supply precomputed vectors, so absent samples can be expected.

panels.title: Inference failures
panels.description: Calls unable to produce a verdict.

panels.title: Feature extraction & scoring throughput
panels.description: These stages need not have identical rates; flow/feature sensor modes can bypass daemon extraction.

panels.title: Sensor connection state
panels.description: Aggregated sensor counts; no sensor identities are exported by these gauges.

panels.title: Live flow-table occupancy
panels.description: Daemon packet-path live table only. Remote flow/feature records are assembled on sensors and do not occupy this table.

panels.title: Retained records
panels.description: Bounded in-memory retained records, not lifetime counters.

panels.title: Flow lifecycle
panels.description: Daemon packet flow table. Remote record-mode sensors bypass it.

panels.title: Retention pressure
panels.description: Bounded retention eviction, distinct from packet loss and firewall drops.

panels.title: Capture collection loss & decode errors
panels.description: Collection loss at distinct stages. These are not OPNsense firewall allow/block counters.

panels.title: Queue loss by stage
panels.description: Separate units/stages are intentionally not summed into a single packet-loss number.

panels.title: Live console delivery
panels.description: Batches contain multiple events; the two rates are not expected to match.

panels.title: Slow console client disconnects
panels.description: WebSocket clients disconnected for a full send queue, not packet or IDS drops.

options.content:
### Coverage & interpretation
- **No data** means the selected series or samples are absent; it never means zero incidents. Check the source, scrape target and time range first.
- **Flow/feature sensors:** classifications and sensor counts can grow while daemon packet-capture and live flow-table panels stay at zero.
- **Capture totals:** queries select `source="_all"` once. Adding per-source series would double-count the same capture traffic.
- **Firewall access / blocks, DNS names, host CPU / RAM, training epochs and neuron activations** are not exported by this endpoint. Use the operator console for asset paths, training and per-flow explanation.
- Detection labels and disagreements are investigation leads. Historical ranges are limited by Prometheus retention, not the daemon's current in-memory history.

panels.title: Remote flow / feature record rate
panels.description: Received SYNPOIP flow/feature records; each reconnect resets its counter.

panels.title: Remote record transport bandwidth
panels.description: Serialized flow/feature payload bytes, not the bandwidth of the observed network.
